requestOutcomes: GET https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/index.jsp -> public viewer HTML loaded.
GET https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/assets/misc/config.js -> SERVICE_PATH empty; public same-host service configuration.
GET https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/index.js -> current REST/WMS route and field usage inspected.
POST /rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel state=10 level=0 -> Bihar districts; code 32 is ROHTAS.
POST /rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel state=10 level=1 codes=32 -> Sasaram subdivision code 01 and map levels.
POST /rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel state=10 level=2 codes=32,01 -> Sasaram circle code 01 and mauza list.
POST /rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel state=10 level=3 codes=32,01,01 -> Sasaram mauza code 0027 and survey choices.
POST /rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref state=10 gisLevels=32,01,01,0027,SS,00,00, srs=0 -> extent and EPSG:32645 returned.
POST /rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY state=10 giscode=SS32010100271260000 at the projected WUP point -> {has_data:N}; extent echoed but no parcel ID.
GET /ScalarDatahandler OP=4 at the projected WUP point -> empty response; no safe parcel ID or geometry.
GET /WMS GetFeatureInfo attempt on VILLAGE_MAP -> PNG image response rather than usable feature JSON; no geometry retained.
POST extent requests for Cadastral Survey and Revisional Survey returned null/no usable extent for the selected Sasaram mauza route.
